name: Lyrics
author: Vibo
description: Synced and plain lyrics from LRCLIB, with Lyrics.ovh as a plain-text fallback. Order or switch off each source in Settings → Providers.

permissionReasons.network:lrclib.net: Look up synced and plain lyrics on LRCLIB

assistant.instructions: Web lyrics from two sources: LRCLIB (synced and plain, plus a free-text search) and Lyrics.ovh (plain text only, exact artist+title, no search). LRCLIB is asked for the exact artist+title (and the song's length when known), and on a miss searches its catalog itself, accepting only the same title and artist within 2 seconds of the length. For a KNOWN track use get_lyrics; add pluginId=lyrics/lrclib or pluginId=lyrics/lyrics-ovh (the bare source name also works) to force one source over local files. search_lyrics is for when exact metadata fails or is unknown: a free-text LRCLIB search returning candidate matches to disambiguate from.

tools.name: search_lyrics
tools.description: Free-text search of the LRCLIB catalog (title/artist keywords) — returns candidate tracks with whether synced lyrics exist. Use when an exact title+artist lookup came back empty
